description: Managed overlay of global Claude Code settings keys. sync-claude.py merges these blocks into ~/.claude/settings.json so Claude-bundled plugin enablement, bundled-skill visibility, and session-wide environment variables stay reproducible across machines and tracked in git. This is NOT the Codex plugin registry (plugins/registry.json, Codex-native) nor the managed standalone skill registry (skills/registry.json); it governs Anthropic-bundled Claude runtime surfaces those registries do not own. Only the declared keys (enabledPlugins, skillOverrides, env) are managed; any other key already in settings.json is preserved untouched.
